title: Buffalo Turkey Meatballs
blurb: Baked rather than fried, with a second dose of buffalo sauce saved for after the meatballs come out, so the glaze doesn't just steam off in the oven.

ingredients.note: such as Frank's Red Hot, divided

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Combine the turkey, egg whites, blue cheese, scallions and 3/4 of the buffalo sauce in a bowl. Form into 1-inch balls and place on the lined baking sheet. Bake 12 to 15 minutes, until barely done.
Meanwhile, whisk the remaining buffalo sauce with the olive oil.

Drain any liquid released by the meatballs and transfer them to a clean sheet of parchment on the same baking sheet. Drizzle a small amount of the buffalo-oil mixture over each meatball. Bake 2 to 3 minutes more.
